desc: Black-and-white portrait of LEGO founder Ole Kirk Christiansen seated at his desk in 1957, centre-right in the frame, writing on a sheet of paper with a pen in his right hand; a rotary telephone and a typewriter sit behind him to the left.

Black-and-white portrait of Ole Kirk Christiansen seated at a desk, centre-right, smiling at the camera while holding a pen over a paper; a rotary telephone and typewriter are visible behind him on the left.

Black-and-white outdoor family photograph from 1922: a group of adults and small children sitting and standing together on grass in a garden, trees filling the background, a hat lying on the grass at lower left.

Black-and-white full-length portrait of Godtfred Kirk Christiansen standing outdoors in a garden in 1950, centre frame, wearing a dark sleeveless sweater over a light shirt and dark trousers, arms crossed, trees behind him.

Black-and-white cropped portrait of Godtfred Kirk Christiansen in 1950, standing outdoors and filling most of the frame from the waist up, wearing a dark sleeveless sweater over a light shirt, trees behind him.

Colour photograph of Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen speaking at a lectern at the 1996 International Management Symposium in St. Gallen, centre-right, wearing a suit and tie with a name badge, a microphone in front of him.

Black-and-white group photograph at the 1996 International Management Symposium award ceremony: four suited men standing in a row under a tent canopy, Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen among them, two of the men holding rolled certificates.
Colour close portrait of Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen outdoors in 2018, centre frame, wearing glasses, a dark coat and a blue scarf, with the blurred buildings of Legoland Billund behind him.

Colour group photograph at the opening of the 2018 Legoland Billund season: Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen, an older man in a dark coat and blue scarf, stands centre-left among Danish royal guests on the left and costumed Legoland staff and children on the right, outdoors on wet asphalt.
Colour photograph of Jorgen Vig Knudstorp speaking indoors in 2010, centre frame from the waist up, wearing a light shirt and a lanyard, holding a small device in both hands.

Daytime exterior of Ole Kirks Hus (the Lion House), a low red-brick house with a red tiled roof and white-framed windows on Hovedgaden in Billund, centre frame, seen from across a paved square under a clear blue sky.
Second daytime angle of Ole Kirks Hus in Billund: the same red-brick house with a red tiled roof, viewed from the side across an empty paved area, a modern grey building visible at far right.

Daytime exterior of the System House (Systemhuset) on the corner of Hovedgaden and Systemvej in Billund, a white three-storey office block with rows of windows filling the centre of the frame, cobbled street in the foreground.

Wide daytime exterior of the white LEGO House in Billund, its stacked-brick form and broad stepped roof terrace filling the frame, oversized red, blue and yellow LEGO bricks on the plaza in the foreground with visitors around them.
Distant daytime view of the white LEGO House in Billund, centre frame under a cloudy sky, seen across an open sandy play area with a yellow climbing frame at left.

Daytime exterior of the white LEGO House in Billund from the entrance side, centre-right, with its tall glass window, stepped terraces with visitors on them, and a person sitting by the entrance at lower centre.

Interior of LEGO House in Billund: the giant Tree of Creativity built from LEGO bricks, a large green tree filling the lower centre of the frame, visitors on walkways and stairs around it under a glass roof.
Interior staircase of LEGO House in Billund: red steps with glass balustrades at lower left and a wall covered in multicoloured LEGO bricks filling the right side of the frame.
Close daytime view of the LEGO House exterior in Billund: wide white steps with yellow treads rising diagonally across the frame toward the white brick facade at upper right.

Daytime exterior of LEGO House at Ole Kirks Plads in Billund, centre frame under a blue sky, with oversized red, blue and yellow LEGO bricks on the plaza in front and visitors sitting and walking around them.

Daytime exterior of the white LEGO House in Billund, centre frame, with its stepped roof terrace, oversized red, blue and yellow LEGO bricks on the plaza, and a person in a red jacket walking at lower right.
Daytime exterior of the LEGO Campus in Billund: a low round building with horizontal wooden slats, centre-left, seen across grass and a winding path, a young tree at right under a blue sky.

Daytime exterior of the LEGO Campus in Billund: a modern multi-storey office block with a projecting yellow volume at upper right, and a giant LEGO minifigure in a red shirt and blue cap standing in the foreground at lower left.

Daytime exterior of the LEGO Campus in Billund: a glass-fronted building with a perforated white panel at left, a giant LEGO minifigure in red and blue waving in the foreground at lower left, and a yellow brick-shaped canopy over the entrance at centre.

Daytime exterior of the LEGO corporate headquarters in Billund: modern office blocks around a paved courtyard, a giant LEGO minifigure standing on a grass island in the centre distance, a perforated white facade at left.
Daytime exterior of the LEGO Innovation House in Billund: a long glass building at left and a large red LEGO logo sign on a white plinth in the right foreground, grass and a curved walkway around it.

Daytime view of the LEGO Campus office complex on Astvej in Billund from across a road, centre-right in the distance: a dark round building, a perforated white block and a yellow-accented block, with a Danish flag on a pole and grass in the foreground.

Colour photograph of Miniland at Legoland Billund in 1977: miniature LEGO houses with red roofs and a white castle-like building filling the centre, real trees and shrubs around them, visitors at far left.
Colour photograph at Legoland Billund in 1977: a black, red and yellow LEGO-built train with passengers on board, centre-right on a track curving through lawns and shrubs, trees behind it.
View looking down into the castle courtyard at Legoland Billund: grey stone towers and dark wooden walkways with red undersides framing the yard, small visitors visible below.

Daytime view of Miniland harbour at Legoland Billund: miniature LEGO ships, a blue crane and stacked containers in the foreground, a red-roofed building at centre-left, and real visitors walking among trees behind.

Daytime view of a log-flume ride structure at Legoland Billund: a tall brown tower and a long elevated flume running from upper centre to the left, wooden fencing and trees in the foreground and background.

Daytime overview of Miniland at Legoland Billund: model aeroplanes on a model airport tarmac in the foreground, a model terminal building in the middle distance, and large real trees and park buildings behind.
Elevated view from the Legotop at Legoland Billund: a Miniland model airport with model planes and a railway track in the foreground, a large model dinosaur and park buildings in the middle distance.
View from the Legoland Billund observation tower over the park: winding paths, ponds and miniature LEGO scenes below, trees filling the middle ground and flat farmland on the horizon.
Interior of the LEGO Shop at Legoland Billund Resort: long shelves of LEGO boxes lining the left wall, shoppers browsing along the aisle, and a display stand with a screen at centre-right.
Interior of a LEGO store in London: a LEGO-built black lamp post and a Leicester Square sign in the foreground, a green LEGO dragon figure behind them, and a shop window at left.
Night exterior of the LEGO Store building at Leicester Square, London: a lit corner building with a clock near the roof, glowing shopfronts at street level and crowds on the pavement below.

Interior of the LEGO Store at Leicester Square, London: life-size LEGO sculptures including a police officer in the right foreground, a judge-like figure and a Big Ben model in the centre, on a display floor.
Daytime exterior of Grene Church near Billund: a red-brick church with a tall tower, centre-left, bare trees around it, a Danish flag on a pole at far left under a blue sky.

Daytime exterior of the LEGO factory at Kladno, Czech Republic, seen from across a road: a long low grey industrial building with a small red LEGO logo, green trucks parked in front and a pedestrian crossing in the foreground.

OpenStreetMap map of Billund, Denmark, at zoom level 13: the town of Billund labelled at lower centre, Billund Airport at upper right, roads and green farmland around, with a red marker at the LEGO headquarters area just north of the town centre.

Page 1 of the 1958-filed, 1961-published US patent drawing for the LEGO toy building brick by Godtfred Kirk Christiansen: six labelled technical figures (Fig. 1 to Fig. 6) showing the brick from several angles on a white page, with the inventor's name at lower right.

Three rows of early wooden LEGO trains displayed in a glass case: a black locomotive with LEGO lettering and a red carriage at the top, red carriages in the middle, and a red locomotive with pale wooden wheels at the bottom.

Four early wooden LEGO toys in a display case: a white and red toy sewing machine with a LEGO badge at bottom left, a wooden abacus with red, black and beige beads at bottom right, a light-wood workbench and anvil-style piece with a mallet and LEGO badge at top right, and a small red and black toy plane-like piece at centre.
Three early plastic toy tractors side by side in a display case, red at left, light grey at centre and gold at right, with technical drawings behind the glass and a portrait panel below it.
Wide view of a dark LEGO House History Collection gallery, with illuminated wall display cases full of LEGO boxes and models behind round black display tables in the foreground.

Close pile of LEGO bricks with a large yellow LEGO plate/brick in the foreground, plus blue, green and red bricks, against a white background.
Single black 2x4 LEGO brick diagonally centred, with 8 studs each marked LEGO, on a textured grey surface; the clearest modern stud-brick close-up in the set.
Top-down dense pile of assorted multicolour LEGO bricks, plates and shapes filling the frame, with studs and tubes visible.

Historical 1957 photograph of a young child at a wooden table building a red, white and yellow LEGO structure, with loose red and white bricks scattered on a black board and a tall cylindrical LEGO tube package with LEGO lettering at left.
LEGO House interior with a bin full of red bricks in the foreground, a small red LEGO model on a white ledge at mid-right, a person seen from behind at top right, and a wall display behind.
Large blue and yellow Duplo bricks showing hollow studs and tube undersides, with a small red standard LEGO brick on top for scale, on white.
Large colourful pile of Duplo pieces, with a pink brick in the foreground, a red boat at top, orange and green pieces, and a green block with the letter D at right.
Large red Duplo brick at bottom centre with small yellow and green standard bricks stacked on top, on a grey studded baseplate filling the background.
Large blue Duplo brick with hollow studs at centre-left, a yellow Duplo brick on top of it at right, and a small red standard brick in the foreground at bottom right for scale, on white.
Extreme macro of a yellow LEGO minifigure face, with two large black dot eyes left and right of centre, a curved black smile at bottom, visible print scratches, and a black edge at top.
Three minifigure leg pairs side by side on white: printed dark grey and red at left, plain pink in the middle, and yellow with side holes at right.

Small LEGO firefighter minifigure at centre-right on stone, in a red helmet and black uniform with green stripes, with real orange flame blurred behind at left and centre; the flame is real fire behind the figure, not a LEGO fire piece.

Giant red LEGO minifigure in a LEGO store, holding a VIP card in its raised hand, with shelves of LEGO boxes behind and below.

Single minifigure at centre bottom among a pile of LEGO bricks, with a yellow head, striped shirt and blue legs, surrounded by green, blue, red and yellow bricks.
LEGO minifigure in a tan helmet riding a dirt bike mid-air, with dirt in the foreground at bottom, blurred green foliage in the background and dust particles in the air.

White LEGO City space shuttle, nose at right and tail and engines at left, with a red and black stripe along the side, on a wooden table, with a laptop blurred at top right.

Finished LEGO Ideas treehouse with a brown trunk at centre, two cabins at top, a green foliage base, a blue stream at bottom right and a crane hook at right side.

Custom LEGO chess board diagonally centred, with a red and blue checkered baseplate, blue pieces at left and top, red pieces at right and bottom, on a red snowflake tablecloth, with a small white coupon at the top right corner.

Unbuilt LEGO Architecture Fallingwater kit contents: box top, an open instruction book with a real Fallingwater photograph at centre right, sealed bags in tan and green at left, and grey baseplates at bottom right, on a black surface; not a built model.

Built LEGO Architecture Buckingham Palace model centred, in tan and grey, with a flag at top centre, a fence and round memorial in the foreground at centre, a red bus at left foreground, and a black base with 'Buckingham Palace' text at bottom.

LEGO model of the Red House Theater in a glass case, with red and white striped walls, a large green pitched roof at centre, a label at bottom right reading 'Ximen Red House', and small minifigures at the base at left and bottom.

LEGOLAND Windsor Houses of Parliament model, with a tall tan clock tower at left-centre and a long palace building at right, under a blue sky, with miniature cars and trees in the foreground and distant visitors in the background at right.

Giant grey LEGO Millennium Falcon on a white table at an exhibition, cockpit at right and dish at centre, with a display card in the foreground and other models behind. Photograph of a real LEGO model, not official artwork.

Man at right foreground smiling, wearing a black LEGO Star Wars t-shirt, with his hand on a tan brick-built figure at centre holding lightsabers, and a black brick-built Darth Vader figure at left, with red and blue lightsabers vertical. A single plain bright-red plastic building block, no text, no logo, lying horizontally at centre frame on a white background. For the founding beat: the first brick of a wooden toy workshop turning to plastic.

A single plain yellow plastic building block, no text, no logo, lying horizontally at centre frame on a white background. For the growth beat: brightly coloured bricks illustrating the phase when products spread and sold fast.

A single plain blue plastic building block, no text, no logo, lying horizontally at centre frame on a white background. For the growth beat: a blue brick illustrating an ever more diverse product system.

A single plain white plastic building block, no text, no logo, lying horizontally at centre frame on a light grey background so the block stands out. For the comeback beat: a clean white brick illustrating a tidy fresh start after the crisis.

A single human hand, no face, no identifiable sleeve, in the upper half of the frame, fitting two generic pale-blue and yellow building blocks together in the lower half on a white background. For the founding and comeback beats: the manual act of assembly, rebuilding brick by brick.

A plain cardboard packing box, no text, no logo, lid open at the top, centred on a white background. For the growth and comeback beats: packing, shipping out, and getting the product into players' hands.

A white sheet of paper at centre frame carrying only rectangular block outlines and arrows joining the blocks, no figures, no readable text, white surroundings. For the founding beat: sketching the idea of an interlocking brick system from scratch.
A plain yellow wooden pencil, no text, pencil tip at upper left, shaft running diagonally down to lower right on a white background. For the founding beat: the founder's first design-drawing tool.
